summary: Added 30 unique, DOI/Crossref-verified primary empirical studies to docs/research/supervisors/psychology-primary.json (58 -> 88 total). Retrieval practice / testing effect and distributed / spaced practice were prioritized up to 8 records each -- the first two topics in the corpus to clear the eventual 'at least 5 topics with >=8 studies' threshold from docs/research/supervisor-evidence-contract.md #1a. Every other mandatory-coverage topic from #7 moved from 4-5 to a uniform 6, keeping the corpus evenly distributed with no topic below 6 and none above 8 (9% of the 88-record total, well under the eventual 35% ceiling). Seven parallel research passes were each given the full 58-DOI batch-1/2 exclusion list up front to avoid the duplicate-rediscovery issue seen in batch 2. Every one of the 30 candidate DOIs was independently re-verified directly against the live Crossref API during compilation (not just trusting each pass's self-report), and a further spot check confirmed four reported second-source URLs (ERIC, PubMed x2, PMC) resolve live. Two structural defects caught by the deterministic --partial gate were fixed before finalizing: one record's second verification source used a bare http:// (non-HTTPS) URL and was replaced with a verified HTTPS Semantic Scholar API source; one record had only a single verification source and was given a second, independently confirmed HTTPS OpenAlex source. No duplicate DOIs or titles were found against the existing 58-record corpus or among the 30 new candidates.
